[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Bendu Carthage''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]]. Carthage commanded the security force of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] assigned to protect [[Precipitator|Imperial Precipitator]] [[Minas-Coth Cray]], and came under the sway of the [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]] [[Bellarius Drade]].<ref name="Game" />
